decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, but the firm's maritime customer base and in-house R&D and testing give it enough related knowledge to absorb the niche requirements, so it is kept for now despite elevated risk.
The medical examination light builds on established professional lighting and LED expertise and has its own website page, so the firm can interpret its early results and improve it.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires sit squarely within the firm's certified manufacturing and industrial customer knowledge, making them a well-absorbed product line with strong continuation prospects.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the core offer, so the firm has deep prior knowledge and market feedback to sustain it.
